key_reasoning.reason: Six components touched — doctor-parse.js, doctor-groups.js, health-controller.js, health-ui.js (all new), plus renderer.js and logger.rs (modified) — across two layers (frontend UI/orchestration and the Rust Tauri command layer). New abstractions were introduced (the grouping/remedy model in doctor-groups.js, the run-orchestration in health-controller.js), but the work reuses the app's established bridge.runner.runStream streaming pattern already wired into renderer.js elsewhere, and logger.rs already had a cfg(windows)/cfg(not(windows)) split for log_dir before this change, which open_log's spawn_open follows.

diffstat reports 13 files changed (2 modified: logger.rs, renderer.js; 11 new). Of the 11 new files, only 4 are production modules (doctor-parse.js, doctor-groups.js, health-controller.js, health-ui.js) — the remaining 7 are test files and fixtures (doctor-groups.test.mjs, doctor-parse.test.mjs, health-controller.test.mjs, health-ui.test.mjs, and 3 fixture .txt files). The raw count still maps to the XL band (11-15 files) per the file-count table, even though the production surface is comparatively modest and the extra files reflect strong test coverage rather than broader system impact.
